duty_percent.description: Quantity text strictly between 0 and 100 percent, optional % suffix; bare 25 means 25%. Rise belongs to the high phase and fall to the low phase.

frequency_hz.description: Quantity text: decimal/scientific Hz, kHz or mHz; bare text is Hz. Parsed inclusive range 0.05–1000 Hz, further constrained by phase/rise/fall limits.

preconditions: Existing finite pulse source; parsed frequency/period/duty and coupled waveform limits all hold
The ideal square pulse-source retains its separate shared experiment timing
effects: Changes only selected source high/low phase lengths; voltage levels, rise/fall, other sources and experiment settings are unchanged
Ordinary undoable electrical edit: running restarts from configured startup; paused stays stale until restart/resume
Returned pulse_timings gives derived configured frequency/period/duty and round-trip quantity text; component.pulse remains authoritative saved seconds
Reapplying current displayed timing preserves waveform bits/history/physics, including reciprocal-rounding cases; ordinary successful command/actor revisions may advance
Equivalent quantity unit text normalizes before retry fingerprinting; frequency versus period alternatives remain different request forms
Allowed in atomic edit.batch; failure preserves the entire prior state

errors.when: Malformed/missing/extra/null fields, both/neither timing alternatives, invalid quantity/unit/range or derived phases failing retained transition/model limits
Source ID does not exist after parameter validation

completion.mode: immediate validated graph edit; ordinary live initialization is observed separately

detailed_schema.x-source-inventory: snapshot.pulse_timings; current finite-pulse-source components only, independently of circuit completeness or accepted simulation
x-timing-relations: Exactly one frequency_hz or period_s plus duty_percent
Both derived phases 1 µs–10 s; period at least 1 ms
Existing rise_s <= derived high_s and fall_s <= derived low_s; transitions and levels are never shortened or rescaled

checks: Constructed pulse-driven RC circuit from blank through public placement/named wiring commands
Configured incomplete source, frequency or unit-period plus percent duty, retaining ramps/levels/settings
Equivalent unit-text retries replay original admission; changed intent refuses; late replay cannot overwrite reopened source
Displayed timing reentry preserves source bits, physical state and history
Incompatible ramps, alternative/type/range/underflow and missing-source requests refuse without state change
Live finite-ramp RC agrees with independent first-order solution within existing 3 mV envelope
Captured source rows follow independent 20 Hz/25-percent piecewise ramp; measured high-width brackets contain 12.5 ms
Ordinary saved phase fields restore derived timing; no new persisted field or file version
limits: Configured high-phase percent includes rise, not a measured threshold duty; accepted source phase lengths are authoritative
Ideal square pulse-source retains separate shared experiment timing
Rise/fall are never silently scaled, output sampling is not automatically changed, and ordinary model/step/work limits still apply
No physical device, complete physical typing/focus/accessibility or visible-latency qualification
